parse_PDB: parse a PDB file and extract N, CA, C atom coordinates and the amino acid sequence
get_coords6d: compute 6D coordinates including Cb-Cb distance, omega, theta, and phi from N, Ca, C atom xyz data
loader: load a PDB file, compute binned 6D contact coordinates, and return a feed dictionary for model training
get_dihedrals: calculate dihedral angles defined by four sets of 3D coordinate points using vector math
get_angles: calculate planar angles defined by three sets of 3D coordinate points using normalized dot products
